deleteUsed: Sites still use this panel, so it can't be deleted
desc: Group links to the services you use into one start page. Add a Web service site of type “Navigation panel” to serve it; visitors on the LAN get LAN addresses automatically.
emptyHelp: Create a panel and add links, then add a Web service site of type “Navigation panel” that uses it. Open the site's domain to see the page.
iconHelp: Choose a built-in icon (Gately modules, common apps and more), or enter an emoji, short text (up to 8 characters) or an image URL (http/https), or upload an image. Leave empty to show the first letter of the name.
iconInline: The uploaded image is stored in the configuration ({size}). Clear it to use the default icon.
iconTextTooLong: Text icons can have up to 8 characters
iconTooLarge: The image is too large. Use one smaller than {size}, or enter an image URL instead
importEmpty: No sites to add: sites with wildcard domains and Close connection sites have no address
lanCidrsHelp: Visitors from these IPs or ranges also get LAN addresses, for example 100.64.0.0/10 for Tailscale. Loopback, private (10/8, 172.16/12, 192.168/16, fc00::/7) and link-local addresses always count as LAN.
lanUrlHelp: Visitors on the LAN open this address; when empty they use the address above too. Visitors can switch between LAN and internet in the top-right corner of the page.
name: Panel name
nameHelp: Only shown in the admin UI. The page shows it when the page title is empty.
noLinks: No links yet. Click “Add link” or add them from Web service sites.
previewHelp: The preview runs no scripts and has no search box; {'{host}'} expands to the admin UI's domain.
sameTab: Open in the same tab (new tab by default)
subtitle: Subtitle
title: Navigation panels
tooManyLinks: A panel can have up to {n} links
unused: No site uses this panel yet
urlInvalid: Enter a full URL, for example https://nas.example.com
varsHelp: Addresses can use variables: {'{host}'} is the domain the visitor used to open the panel, {'{STUN_web_PORT}'} and {'{STUN_web_ADDR}'} are a STUN rule's public port and address. A link whose variable has no value yet shows as unavailable.
iconBuiltin: Built-in icon: {name}. Change the background color below.
iconBuiltinMissing: This built-in icon doesn't exist in this version
altsHelp: Other ways to reach the same service, such as IPv6, frp, STUN or a Cloudflare tunnel. They appear as small links on the card, open in a new tab, and are shown to LAN and internet visitors alike.
altNameRequired: Enter a name for each access method
